summary: Refine NVFP4 decode tiles and expand supported dense and MoE quantization
details: Use compact N16 token layouts and paired input producers for eligible NVFP4 decode kernels.
Include half-resident and three-quarter-resident grids in runtime tuning while enforcing the device residency limit.
Add safetensors IQ2_XS dense and expert-weight support without changing existing checkpoint formats.
